P.O.Box 799045 Dallas, Texas 75379-9045 Global Headquarters 16251 Dallas Parkway Addison, Texas 75001 Locate Mary Kay Offices & Locations Mary Kay Museum Mary Kay Ash Foundation Frequently Asked Questions Ordering Products How do I purchase Mary Kay products? Mary Kay products are available on-line or in person exclusively through independent beauty consultants.  How do I find an Independent Beauty Consultant? Use the Consultant Connector on our website to find an independent beauty consultant. Simply enter your zip code into the Consultant Connector and find an independent beauty consultant within your chosen radius. Get in touch for a consultation or shop directly in the online store. Do you already have (or have you had in the past) an independent beauty consultant? In the Consultant Connector , you can also search for an independent beauty consultants by name or phone number. Have questions about your order? Your Independent Beauty Consultant is your best resource! You’ll find her name in your order confirmation email. If you’re unable to reach your consultant or she is no longer active in her Mary Kay® business, please contact Mary Kay® Customer Service at: 1-800-MARY KAY (1-800-627-9529) Can I cancel my order? If you would like to cancel your order, please contact the Customer Success Team at 800-MARYKAY. Please note: changes may not be possible once the order has been submitted with payment. Can I return or exchange a Mary Kay product? If you are not fully satisfied with your Mary Kay® product purchased from an authorized Independent Beauty Consultant within one year from the purchase date, it will be replaced, exchanged, or refunded in full upon return to the authorized Consultant. If your Consultant is no longer selling Mary Kay, you can return the product to the Company with valid proof of purchase within one year or less. Who can I contact about my online order? Please direct any questions about your order or ordered products to your Independent Beauty Consultant, whose name is listed in your order confirmation email. If your Independent Beauty Consultant is unavailable, or if she is no longer active in her Mary Kay® business, please contact: Mary Kay Inc. at 1-800-MARY KAY (1-800-627-9529) Shipping & Delivery Can I have my order delivered to another country? Deliveries are currently only available within the United States, Puerto Rico, Guam and U.S. Virgin Islands. Become a Beauty Consultant If I am interested in becoming a Beauty Consultant, who do I contact? Here you will find a lot of information and answers to questions about the Mary Kay Business Opportunity. If you would like to learn more about becoming an Independent Beauty Consultant with Mary Kay, please contact your Beauty Consultant. She/he will be happy to advise you and answer all your questions about starting a Mary Kay business.   HOW CAN WE HELP? You've been helping us make space for women to learn, grow and become more since 1963. Since 1963, it has been our mission to enrich the lives of women and their families. What began THEN, what we stand for TODAY and what will ALWAYS be our mission: enriching women’s lives.  We empower women around the world to build their businesses on their own terms, selling high quality Mary Kay products and inspiring beauty and confidence in their communities.  Our Founder: Mary Kay Ash Mary Kay Ash was a visionary leader ahead of her time, all the time. Over 60 years ago, she flipped the script on “business as usual,” launching a timeless beauty brand built on purpose and designed to give women a pathway to entrepreneurship. She didn’t just challenge the workplace — she rewrote the rules, and showed what happens when you believe in the power of women.  Her approach was simple and unshakeable: stay true to your values, work hard, and make everyone feel important. Mary Kay Ash’s legacy isn’t just iconic, her passion for recognition, mentorship, and community sparked a movement that empowered millions and continues to fuel our global brand today.   See Her Story Our Product Promise: We Always Put You First At Mary Kay, your safety is our highest priority. We are dedicated to ensuring the highest standards of safety, quality, and performance of our products through rigorous review, investigation, and testing.  And, because we are confident that you will be delighted by the benefits you see, we stand behind the products you buy from your Independent Beauty Consultant with a Mary Kay ® Satisfaction Guarantee. See Our Product Promise Our Sustainability Our mission of enriching the lives of women around the globe has remained at our core for more than 60 years of our business, from providing a unique business opportunity to preserving the planet we are creating a better world for women. We recognize that true sustainability is not just about reducing our carbon footprint or recycling; it’s about creating a business that values and uplifts every individual, especially women, fosters social well-being and ensures economic growth that benefits everyone. See Our Sustainability Report Our Purpose: Lived. Elevated. Always Passed On. At Mary Kay, Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared™ is more than a catchy slogan. For us, it’s about a deeper purpose and meaning. It means beauty grows when it’s passed on. From community to community, generation to generation, woman to woman. Beauty shared – through the way we care, guide and make space for one another – connects us and shapes who we become. Learn More   HOW CAN WE HELP?
